description:
ML-based charset encoding detector.  MojibusterEncodingDetector
    runs structural detectors for UTF-32 / UTF-16 / UTF-8 and then a
    33-class byte-bigram Naive Bayes classifier covering CJK multi-byte,
    EBCDIC, DOS OEM, Cyrillic, Windows single-byte, ISO-8859, and Mac
    encodings.  This detector replaces ICU4J and juniversalchardet as the
    default statistical encoding detector in Tika.
